title: Soundness Contracts
goal: Distinguish between unsafe code and unsound safe abstractions.

sections.text: A function marked safe promises that no input can cause undefined behavior.

sections.caption: Safe functions must not expose undefined behavior.

sections.text: If a function cannot validate its inputs internally, it must be marked `unsafe`.

sections.caption: Marking the function unsafe requires callers to uphold invariants.

sections.text: Sound safe abstractions check inputs before calling `unsafe` code.

explanation: Distinguish between unsafe code and unsound safe abstractions.
